task.description:
Design the GET /instances/:id and GET /instances (list) endpoints for API-03 (Instance management).

API-03 requires these endpoints (the other two — POST /instances and POST /instances/:id/cancel — are already implemented in src/api/routes/instances.zig via EE-01 and EE-08 RELEASED work):

1. GET /instances/:id — returns instance state: status, current_tasks, variables, started_at. HTTP 404 if not found. Any authenticated role.
2. GET /instances — lists instances, paginated (API-06), filterable by status and definition_id. Any authenticated role.

Produce a design artifact at src/design/api-03-instance-management.md covering:
- Request/response types (Zig structs) for both endpoints
- Pagination parameter handling (page, per_page, links) per API-06 conventions
- Filter parameter handling (status, definition_id query params)
- Error response codes for each endpoint
- How to call instance_mod and task_mod to fetch instance state + current tasks
- What fields to expose in GET /instances/:id response (instance_id, status, current_tasks[], variables, started_at, completed_at if terminal)
- What fields to expose in GET /instances list response (instance_id, status, definition_id, started_at)

Follow the pattern established in src/design/api-02-definition-crud.md. Do not write implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers both GET /instances/:id and GET /instances list endpoints
Pagination and filtering strategy is specified
Error codes for all failure modes are enumerated

result.summary: Design artefact for api-03-instance-management: covers GET /instances/:id (full instance state with current tasks) and GET /instances (paginated list filterable by status and definition_id). Includes Zig struct signatures for new InstanceStore methods (getById, list), pagination cursor strategy (keyset pagination on started_at DESC + instance_id DESC), filter parameter handling, error taxonomy, data flow diagrams, and SQL query sketches. Three open questions flagged for BACKEND-DEV decision (cursor expiry encoding, two-query vs single-connection for getById, variables serialisation format).
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) to implement handleGetById and handleList in src/api/routes/instances.zig and add getById/list methods to src/engine/instance.zig
